INSERT INTO packages (residentId, packageType, totalHours, usedHours, startDate, endDate, isActive, createdAt, updatedAt)
SELECT 
  r.id,
  '15h_8w',
  0.0167,
  0,
  CURDATE(),
  DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 8 WEEK),
  true,
  NOW(),
  NOW()
FROM residents r
WHERE r.firstName = 'enka' AND r.lastName = 'enka';
